description: Commercial invoice issued by a vendor to a customer. Captures header, parties, totals, and line-item table.

description.instruction: Full description of the product or service line

quantity.instruction: Number of units billed for this line

unit_price.instruction: Per-unit price in the invoice currency

amount.instruction: Extended amount for the line (quantity * unit_price)

invoice_date.instruction: Date the invoice was issued, ISO 8601 if possible

purchase_order.instruction: Customer purchase order number referenced on the invoice

vendor_name.instruction: Legal name of the vendor / seller

vendor_tax_id.instruction: Vendor tax / VAT / EIN identifier if shown

bill_to_name.instruction: Name of the party being billed

currency.instruction: Three-letter currency code (USD, EUR, etc.). Infer from currency symbols if not explicit.

subtotal.instruction: Sum of line items before tax and discounts

tax_total.instruction: Total tax amount on the invoice

line_items.instruction: All billable lines on the invoice
